```{r setup}
project_root <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
setwd(project_root)

options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v5")

pacman::p_load(Seurat, data.table, tidyverse, hdf5r)
```


#Gene Counts
```{r}
# Read in the cellranger counts, transcripts in rows and cells in columns
tx_counts <- Read10X_h5("A1_single_cell_data/raw_data/a1_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5") %>%
  as.data.frame()

dim(tx_counts) # 153,364 transcripts, 2,528 sequenced cells

# Transcript to gene map
tx2gene <- read.csv("tx2gene_katia/tx2gene_nvir_katia.csv")
```


```{r}
# Summarize tx to genes. The dense table takes ~4 min and ~10 GB RAM
tx_counts <- tx_counts %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "TXNAME") %>%
  left_join(tx2gene, by = "TXNAME")

setDT(tx_counts)
gene_counts <- tx_counts[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = GENEID, .SDcols = is.numeric] # Dplyr takes too long, this is more efficient
setkey(gene_counts, GENEID)

nrow(gene_counts) # 139,019 genes, before merging by symbol
```


```{r}
# Load in annotations
annotations <- read.csv("Nvir_Annotations/Nvir Latest Annotation Katia/Nvir_annotations_MT_Katia_final.csv", header = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL = ifelse(GENEID == "g.345663", "ACTA2.1", SYMBOL)) %>% # Smooth muscle actin was labeled with a protein name ACTS
  mutate(SYMBOL = ifelse(grepl("^g\\.", SYMBOL), SYMBOL, str_to_sentence(str_remove(SYMBOL, "\\.[0-9]+$"))), # Tmp, Tmp.1, Tmp.2 are copies of one gene and become Tmp. Unannotated g. genes keep their ID
         SYMBOL = gsub("_", "-", SYMBOL)) # Seurat swaps "_" for "-" in gene names

gene2symbol <- annotations %>%
  select(SYMBOL, GENEID) %>%
  distinct(GENEID, .keep_all = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Annotated cell / counts matrix. Genes with the same symbol are summed up
gene_counts <- gene_counts %>%
  left_join(gene2symbol, by = "GENEID") %>%
  select(-GENEID)

setDT(gene_counts)
gene_counts <- gene_counts[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = SYMBOL]

gene_counts <- gene_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")

nrow(gene_counts) # 83,679 genes
sum(!grepl("^g\\.", rownames(gene_counts))) # 15,072 of them with a symbol, the rest are unannotated g. genes
```


```{r}
# Seurat object
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = gene_counts,
                          project = "A1_Cells",
                          min.cells = 3,
                          min.features = 200)

seu # 23,818 genes
```


#Filtering
```{r}
# QC metrics

# Mitochondrial genes. The mitochondrial transcripts are unannotated g. contigs, found by their InterPro description. Only MT-Nd5 and MT-TH match by MT- name
mito_genes <- annotations %>%
  filter(grepl("^(cytochrome b|cytochrome c oxidase subunit (I|II|III)|NADH dehydrogenase subunit [1-6L]+|ATP synthase F0 subunit [68])$", Description_IP)) %>%
  pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  union(grep("^Mt-", rownames(seu), value = TRUE)) %>%
  intersect(rownames(seu))

seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, features = mito_genes)

# Mapping rate and mismatches per 100 bp per cell, calculated from the cellranger BAM
mapping <- read.csv("A1_single_cell_data/raw_data/a1_mapping_per_cell.csv")

seu$percent.mapped <- mapping$percent.mapped[match(colnames(seu), mapping$cell)]
seu$mismatch.rate <- mapping$mismatch.rate[match(colnames(seu), mapping$cell)]
```


```{r}
# Dynamic QC thresholds, median +/- 3 MADs on the log scale: genes and UMIs in both directions, mapping rate only downwards
# Mitochondrial reads have a hard cutoff of 5 %, as 3 MADs allowed up to 17.7 %
n_mads <- 3

is_outlier <- function(x, type) {
  lx <- log1p(x)
  lo <- median(lx) - n_mads * mad(lx) # Lower bound
  hi <- median(lx) + n_mads * mad(lx) # Higher bound
  switch(type,
         both = lx < lo | lx > hi,
         lower = lx < lo)
}

qc <- seu@meta.data %>%
  mutate(out_feature = is_outlier(nFeature_RNA, "both"),
         out_count = is_outlier(nCount_RNA, "both"),
         out_mt = percent.mt > 5, # Hard cutoff
         out_mapped = is_outlier(percent.mapped, "lower"),
         keep = !out_feature & !out_count & !out_mt & !out_mapped & nFeature_RNA >= 200)

# Cells lost per rule, 2,097 kept
qc %>%
  summarise(cells = n(),
            out_feature = sum(out_feature),
            out_count = sum(out_count),
            out_mt = sum(out_mt),
            out_mapped = sum(out_mapped),
            kept = sum(keep))


# Filtering
seu$qc_keep <- qc$keep

seu <- subset(seu, subset = qc_keep)
```


#Normalization
```{r}
# Normalized values are in seu[["RNA"]]$data
seu <- NormalizeData(seu) # Log normalization with scale.factor = 10.000 is default

# HVG
seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu,
                            selection.method = "vst",
                            nfeatures = 2000)
```


#First Clustering
```{r}
# Clustered once before the cell cycle regression, to find the cells that are not N. viridescens. Standard pipeline on the variable genes
seu <- ScaleData(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu))

seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu))

set.seed(42)
seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:20)

set.seed(42)
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 1)


# Mapping rate and mismatches per cluster, the numbers in the Methods
seu@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(cells = n(),
            median_mapped = median(percent.mapped),
            median_mismatch = median(mismatch.rate),
            median_mt = median(percent.mt),
            median_features = median(nFeature_RNA))
```


# Annotation
```{r}
# Cluster 6 maps worse, has twice the mismatches and almost no mitochondrial reads: residual P. waltl cells of the multiplexed 10x run
# The 3 MAD mapping-rate threshold only removes the worst of them, so the cluster is excluded by ID. It keeps the Translation_hi name of the first analysis
cluster_id_all <- ifelse(levels(seu) == "6", "Translation_hi", "Translation")
names(cluster_id_all) <- levels(seu)

seu <- RenameIdents(seu, cluster_id_all)

seu$cell_type <- Idents(seu)


# Excluded vs kept cells, the numbers in the Methods
seu@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(cells = n(),
            median_mapped = median(percent.mapped),
            median_mismatch = median(mismatch.rate),
            median_mt = median(percent.mt))
```


```{r}
# Clean object, N. viridescens cells only
a1_clean <- subset(seu, subset = cell_type == "Translation")

a1_clean # 1,912 cells
```


#Cell-cycle regression
```{r}
# Reprocessing from the clean cells. Variable genes and scaling are redone on them
a1_clean <- NormalizeData(a1_clean)

a1_clean <- FindVariableFeatures(a1_clean,
                                 selection.method = "vst",
                                 nfeatures = 2000)


# CC genes: the Seurat S and G2M lists, matched to the newt symbols without their -a/-b suffixes
cell_cycle <- data.frame(SYMBOL = rownames(a1_clean)) %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL_cc = str_to_upper(str_remove(SYMBOL, "-.*")))

s.genes <- cell_cycle %>%
  filter(SYMBOL_cc %in% cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes) %>%
  pull(SYMBOL)

g2m.genes <- cell_cycle %>%
  filter(SYMBOL_cc %in% cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes) %>%
  pull(SYMBOL)


# Assign each cell a score, based on its expression of G2/M and S phase markers
a1_clean <- CellCycleScoring(a1_clean,
                             s.features = s.genes,
                             g2m.features = g2m.genes,
                             set.ident = TRUE)

# Regressing out the CC scores while scaling all genes. Results are in a1_clean[["RNA"]]$scale.data
a1_clean <- ScaleData(a1_clean,
                      vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
                      features = rownames(a1_clean))
```


#Clustering
```{r}
# Linear dimensional reduction on the variable genes after CC regression
a1_clean <- RunPCA(a1_clean,
                   features = VariableFeatures(object = a1_clean))

set.seed(42)
a1_clean <- FindNeighbors(a1_clean,
                          dims = 1:15) # Which PC's to take as input

set.seed(42)
a1_clean <- FindClusters(a1_clean, resolution = 0.5) # At 1 the 7 clusters were pairwise very similar, 0.5 gives 4
```


# Cluster names
```{r}
# All express Acta2, Tagln and Vim
cluster_names <- c("0" = "TE-high",         # Retrotransposon-derived genes (Peg10, Gag, Pol, Ty3b, Tf2)
                   "2" = "ECM-high",        # Matrix genes (Mgp, Mmp13, Mmp14, Tgfbi) and the TGF-b feedback inhibitors Bambi and Pmepa1
                   "1" = "G2M-high",        # Most G2/M cells (38%), proliferation genes (Ube2c, Cdc20, Kpna2, H2ax, H4)
                   "3" = "G1/OxPhos-high")  # Cells enriched in G1 (59%), respiratory chain (Ndufs6, Cox5a, Uqcrb) and ribosomal genes up most strongly, fewest mitochondrial reads

name_per_cell <- unname(cluster_names[as.character(a1_clean$seurat_clusters)]) # Without names, or Seurat matches them to the cell names
a1_clean$cluster_name <- factor(name_per_cell, levels = cluster_names)

Idents(a1_clean) <- "cluster_name" # seurat_clusters keeps the IDs

table(a1_clean$cluster_name, a1_clean$seurat_clusters) # Cluster sizes
```


#UMAP
```{r}
set.seed(42)
a1_clean <- RunUMAP(a1_clean, dims = 1:15)

saveRDS(a1_clean, file = "A1_single_cell_data/objects/a1_clean.rds")
```
